clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952 and the purchase of the apple orchard, within the year: June grew homesick and wrote daily to her sister Edna, then kept to her bed for weeks that first winter; Walter spent long hours out in the trees and grew distant from June; Glen started fights at his new school; Walter stopped writing to his brother Harlan after a quarrel over their father's land money; Walter and June had rows over money for new trees. By September 1953, June had joined the church choir and her letters thinned out, marking a shift toward settling. Roy's year kept back at school is not dated with certainty and falls outside the cluster.

clusters.name: The orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the whole crop and the bank called in the loan, within the following year: Walter drank heavily most nights; he and Glen blamed each other for the loan; Glen and Marian took over the family's money and talks with the bank; Carl's asthma attacks worsened that winter; Nora began wetting the bed in April 1969; Ida's heart trouble was found and she was told to stop working at the bakery. By October 1969, Walter stopped drinking and took work pruning other men's trees, and Carl's asthma eased once spring came. Glen's cutoff from his father is not dated with certainty.

clusters.name: Glen's job loss at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen's job loss when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within the following year: Glen sat in the truck in the yard for hours most of that year; Glen and Marian had loud fights at night over money; Marian took a second job cleaning offices at night; Nora stopped eating properly and lost weight that summer; Nora kept to her room and grew distant from her mother; Walter drank again after six years sober; by June 1976, Nora was eating again and made the track team. Tess's nightmares and Carl's time away at his girlfriend's house do not date with certainty and are set aside.

clusters.name: Hollis's mother moving into the house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma moving into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990, within the following year: Nora clashed with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals; Hollis worked late and kept out of the kitchen rows, growing distant from Nora; Hollis took his mother's side; Owen had tantrums at preschool; Wilma took over Lily's care; Nora's eczema flared on both hands; Nora and Hollis had rows most nights; Marian drove over twice a week to take Nora's side. By June 1991, Wilma took a flat in town, and Nora's eczema cleared over the summer. The shifts all belong to the period of family disturbance around Wilma's arrival and its settling when she moved out.
